properties.entry: SELECT E.EMP_ID , E.EMP_NAME , E.SALARY , D.DEPT_TITLE , J.JOB_NAME FROM EMPLOYEE E LEFT JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON E.DEPT_CODE = D.DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN JOB J ON J.JOB_CODE = E.JOB_CODE ORDER BY E.EMP_ID ASC
SELECT EMP_NAME , DEPT_TITLE FROM EMPLOYEE E , DEPARTMENT D , JOB J WHERE E.DEPT_CODE = D.DEPT_ID AND E.JOB_CODE = J.JOB_CODE AND D.DEPT_TITLE LIKE '%'||?||'%'
SELECT EMP_NAME , JOB_NAME FROM EMPLOYEE E LEFT JOIN JOB J USING(JOB_CODE) LEFT JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON(E.DEPT_CODE = D.DEPT_ID) WHERE JOB_NAME = ?
SELECT ROWNUM , A.* FROM ( SELECT EMP_ID , EMP_NAME , EMP_NO , JOB_CODE , nvl(SALARY,0) AS SALARY FROM EMPLOYEE WHERE SALARY > 0 ORDER BY SALARY DESC ) A WHERE ROWNUM <= 5
SELECT ROWNUM , A.* FROM ( SELECT EMP_ID , EMP_NAME , EMP_NO , JOB_CODE , nvl(SALARY,0) AS SALARY FROM EMPLOYEE WHERE SALARY > 0 ORDER BY SALARY ASC ) A WHERE ROWNUM <= 5
INSERT INTO EMPLOYEE( EMP_ID , EMP_NAME , EMP_NO , JOB_CODE , SAL_LEVEL) VALUES ((SELECT COUNT(*) + 200 FROM EMPLOYEE) , ? , ? , ? , ?)
UPDATE EMPLOYEE SET SALARY = ? , JOB_CODE = ? , DEPT_CODE = ? WHERE EMP_ID = ?
UPDATE EMPLOYEE SET ENT_YN = ? , ENT_DATE = TO_DATE(?, 'yyyymmdd') WHERE EMP_ID = ?
